description: Hybrid search: FTS5 across all layers plus semantic ranking for memories, traits and pending episodes. Reinforces returned memories (Hebbian) unless MISMEM_REINFORCE_ON_RECALL=off. Each hit carries its layer, the UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD), the details of a memory, the polarity of a trait when it is not neutral, and truncated when a string was clipped to fit the reply. When truncated is true, mem_get_observation with the id returns the full text. Use when the user asks something that may already be stored, and to check what is known about a scope.

reinforce.description: false for a search the user did not ask for (a hook injecting context): it is not use, so it must not raise salience

name: recall
